title: Chicken Quorma (Aromatic Chicken with Yogurt)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A rich, aromatic dish for weddings and special occasions, taught to the author in Karachi by Sara Hussain. More involved than most recipes here; the one to cook for a guest you want to impress.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot on medium-high (7/10), 2 min:
Add and fry, stirring often, 20+ min, until evenly deep brown and almost crisp, not burnt:
items: 2 medium onions (1 lb / 450 g total), quartered and thinly sliced
Stay at medium-high; higher heat browns unevenly

steps.action: Remove from heat; lift the onions onto a plate lined with 4 paper towels.
If less than ½ cup oil remains, top up; heat on medium-high 1 min:
items: Up to ¼ cup oil (60 ml)

steps.action: Add and fry at least 2 min, until granular and separated from the oil; do not burn:
Add and fry, stirring occasionally, 10+ min, until no pink remains and the released water is nearly gone:
items: 2.2 lb whole chicken (1 kg), skinned, in about 12 pieces (or 1 kg skinned bone-in parts)

steps.action: Stir together, then add slowly while stirring:
Cover; simmer on medium (5/10) 20 min, stirring and scraping once at 10 min.
items: Meanwhile, crush the fried onions by hand, a little at a time, into a coarse oily powder

steps.action: Stir; reduce to low (2/10), add, cover, and cook undisturbed 10 min:
items: 2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), peeled, julienned in 1 in (2.5 cm) slivers

steps.action: Stir in; turn off heat, cover, and rest 5 min:

items: Raita and plain bread; naan if possible
